tasks.short: Report bus malfunctions and needed repairs

steps.what: Report bus malfunctions or needed repairs with clear observed symptoms and circumstances

tasks.design: Keep direct fault reporting to the controller through the {TELEPHONY} or existing reporting channel. The driver explains observations and checks that the concern has been received; no diagnosis or vehicle-release decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report depends on the observed symptoms and immediate circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed within this short communication boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining an intermittent fault clearly without confusing observation with diagnosis.
tasks.human_edge: The driver knows what happened and can answer follow-up questions.
tasks.altitude: Reporting responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the observed circumstances of a reported vehicle concern

evidence.claim: Direct reporting of an observed vehicle concern remains human work; the digest's log tools do not establish a saving for this communication.

assumptions: Boundary is fault communication, not physical inspection, maintenance work or a separate repair log.
Driver produces observed symptoms, vehicle identity and context directly. No structured fault or safe-to-drive code is assumed.
Existing native reporting channels remain sufficient; no new capture, system or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Local reporting channels and response procedures
research_questions: Do repair staff receive enough factual symptom context without unnecessary repeat calls?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and incremental=0. Routine concerns and urgent malfunctions retain direct reporting time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Maintain knowledge of first-aid procedures through approved learning and practical refreshers

tasks.design: Keep approved learning and practical refreshers intact. Existing learning materials in the {LMS} may support revision, but time spent building and retaining knowledge is not removed by generating summaries.
tasks.previous_blocker: Knowledge has to be understood and practised by the driver.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed to replace that learning.
tasks.still_hard: Retaining practical competence between refresher sessions.
tasks.human_edge: The driver recognises the situation and applies the training within their competence.
tasks.altitude: Learning requirements and responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check that required refresher evidence is current
reach.learn: Applicable training requirements and record boundaries

evidence.claim: First-aid learning and practice remain personal work; no time reduction is assumed from an information lookup tool.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining knowledge, not providing medical treatment or administering training records.
Approved instructor and training provider produce the materials and feedback through existing training. No structured competence flag is inferred by software.
Native learning access stays as today. No new tool, recording or ongoing upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Which parts of approved training need more practical reinforcement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100 with incremental=0. Study and practical refresher time are retained in full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and submit school-bus activity reports

steps.what: Capture student or trip counts, hours worked, mileage and fuel details
Prepare reports by totalling checked trip, hour, mileage and fuel entries
Check and submit the activity report, explaining missing or unusual entries

tasks.design: Configure a short trip form in the {OTHER} transport record system, keeping all driver capture time. Deterministic totals create the report from those checked fields; the driver checks it against source facts and submits the exact version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drivers may re-total and format trip facts already collected during the reporting period.
tasks.enabler_now: A native form and report can reuse explicit entries without a language model.
tasks.still_hard: Missing readings, changed trips and ensuring counts are not confused with unique students.
tasks.human_edge: The driver checks what actually happened and explains exceptions.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate report compilation; trip capture and accountability stay with the driver.

reach.task: Trace a report total to its underlying trip entries

evidence.claim: Deterministic totals can compile explicitly captured trip facts; the proposed saving is unmeasured, and the digest found no measured bus-reporting case.

assumptions: Boundary is driver report preparation and submission, not driving, passenger assistance or administrator processing. Existing automatic logs earn no new human saving.

Driver s1 produces vehicle ID, trip ID/date, actual trip count, aggregate passenger count, work start/end and non-working intervals, start/end odometer and fuel quantity/receipt reference in a native form. All observation, counting, entry and correction retain 40 hours.

Machine s2 uses those exact fields and checked reporting-period rules. It sums trips and passenger journeys separately, calculates distance from paired readings and hours from explicit intervals, and flags gaps or impossible values rather than inventing them.

No tachograph applicability, telematics feed, electronic passenger check-in or structured pupil roster is assumed. Missing facts require driver resolution or manual compilation, within the retained checks only where feasible.
Test native transport reports first. Do not collect student names for aggregate reporting or use these records for new driver scoring.
research_questions: Does generated compilation save time after all capture and source checks are included?

already_counted.description: Reconcile report totals, resolve missing entries and check submission

incremental.description: Maintain field definitions and inspect report failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact reporting period, trip-entry snapshot, totals, exception notes and intended recipient checked before submission; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=40+0+20=60. Gross 40 less 2 upkeep gives net 38. High requires a 40-hour duplicate compilation slice, complete captured inputs and checks within 20 hours. Low assumes native reports already exist or manual fallback; driving and capture time do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report delays, accidents and traffic situations

steps.what: Report delays, accidents and transportation situations using telephones or mobile two-way radios

tasks.design: Keep direct situation reporting through the {TELEPHONY} or existing two-way radio. The driver communicates the actual circumstances and checks understanding without waiting for an automated incident summary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful reporting needs current context and clear communication.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is proposed within this short direct-report boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining location, immediate needs and uncertainty during a changing situation.
tasks.human_edge: The driver reports what is actually happening and answers controller questions.
tasks.altitude: Situation-reporting time and authority stay unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the sequence and location of a reported transport incident

evidence.claim: Direct operational incident reporting retains driver time; log-automation capability does not replace the communication.

assumptions: Boundary is immediate verbal reporting, not later accident forms, routine trip totals or controller follow-up work.
Driver directly produces situation, location and trip context. No structured delay or accident code is assumed as a machine input.
Existing native radio or phone procedures remain as today; no new capture or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Approved communication channels and reporting procedures
research_questions: Which report details most often need clarification by the controller?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and incremental=0. Routine delay reports and urgent incidents retain direct communication time.

reach: Trace report totals and clarify factual incident context with a transportation inspector
